name: Sk Kaken Co.,Ltd.
summary: Sk Kaken Co.,Ltd. manufactures and sells organic and inorganic water-based coating materials, synthetic resin paints, inorganic coating materials, and inorganic building materials in Japan, Asia, and internationally. The company is also involved in the contracting of special finishing works; and manufacture and sale of heat insulation materials, fireproof coating materials and paints, and contracting of fireproof insulation works, as well as various chemical products.
